question: I'm a CS 5th-year student currently on academic warning. Looking at my Fall 2025 enrollment (11-411, 11-345, 17-437, 10-423), does my current course load satisfy CS satisfactory progress requirements for that semester?
expected_answer: The CS satisfactory progress milestones are defined for the first four years (First-Year Spring through Junior Spring). By 5th year, the milestone benchmarks have already passed. Satisfactory progress for continued academic warning or to resolve academic warning requires earning a semester QPA above 2.0 and making progress toward degree completion. The courses listed (NLP, Undergrad Independent Study, Web App Dev, Generative AI) are upper-level or graduate courses appropriate for a 5th-year student. The key question is whether P-009 earns above a 2.0 this semester.
reasoning_type: Policy application to non-standard academic trajectory
common_mistake: Applying junior-year milestones to a 5th-year student; not recognizing that for 5th-year students, the key satisfactory progress measure shifts to QPA and degree completion rate
needs_verification: Confirm that 11-345 (Undergrad Independent Study) is permitted while on academic warning — this may be blocked by the academic action policy
Confirm Fall 2025 grades for P-009 to determine if QPA requirement was met
Confirm the 5th-year satisfactory progress standard as applied by the CS department at CMU-Q
